transcript: Did you know that if you place two drops of real lavender oil on your pillow every night before sleep, this can help slow your heart rate, quiet a racing mind, and give you the deepest sleep you have had in years? Western doctors have no explanation for this, my friend. They never will. But in ancient Chinese medicine, soldiers bathed in lavender water after battle, not for cleanliness, for recovery. It told the body the danger was over, that it was safe to rest and heal. Two drops every night. Your body will remember what real sleep feels like. Try this for one week. You will feel the difference. Comment yes if you are going to try this, and follow me for more ancient healing wisdom.
